extDescription.message: Review a website's translations in context: original and translation side by side, correct texts directly.

connectHelp.message: Paste the review link you received from Supertext (it starts with https:// and contains /review#).

errorBadLink.message: This isn't a review link. Copy the whole link from the email or message.

errorPermission.message: The extension needs permission to read the review service and the website. Click Connect again and allow it.

errorUnauthorized.message: This review link is not valid. Ask Supertext for a new one.

errorExpired.message: This review link has expired. Ask Supertext for a new one.

errorRevoked.message: This review link was revoked. Ask Supertext for a new one.

errorNetwork.message: The review service can't be reached. Check your connection and try again.

errorMarkup.message: The correction changes the formatting or links, which isn't allowed. Keep the tags as they are and only change the words.

errorReviewer.message: Enter your name first, so Supertext knows who made the change.

reviewMode.message: Select texts by clicking (links don't open)

splitHint.message: Your Chrome can't open the pages side by side by itself. Press Shift+Alt+N (Mac: Cmd+Option+N), or right-click the tab and choose the split view entry.

noPrefixHint.message: Open the original and the translated page yourself; the extension recognizes them when both are side by side.

notOnSite.message: Open a page of the website to start.

emptyPage.message: No translated texts found on this page yet.

emptyUnmatched.message: Every text on this page belongs to a translation.

emptyInvisible.message: No invisible texts on this page.

unmatchedUntranslated.message: Not translated: the page shows the original text.

unmatchedOther.message: Not from the translated content: probably the theme, a template, a script or content that was never sent for translation.

markupHint.message: This text has formatting or links. Change only the words between the tags.

saved.message: Saved. The website shows it after the next update of this page in the CMS.

selectHint.message: Click a highlighted text on the page or in the list to review it.

severalSources.message: This text appears with $COUNT$ different originals.
